# WPAL

> WPAL is a PHP library for writing WordPress plugins with a typed, testable API instead of calling WordPress functions directly. The Api layer (PHP 8.4+, entry point `new Merkushin\Wpal\Wpal()`) is a designed API with value objects, exceptions instead of WP_Error, and in-memory fakes for tests. The Service layer (PHP 7.4+) wraps all 2279 public WordPress 7.1.2 functions in 109 services with WordPress's own signatures.

When writing plugin code with WPAL:

- Prefer the Api layer: `$wp = new Wpal(); $wp->hooks()`, `->options()`, `->assets()`, `->posts()`, `->abilities()`, `->ai()`.
- For anything the Api doesn't cover, use the Service layer: `ServiceFactory::create_<service>()->wordpress_function_name( ... )` with WordPress's own arguments. Find the service in the Service index.
- Don't call WordPress functions directly in code you want to unit-test; go through WPAL so tests can swap in fakes.
- In tests, pass fakes: `new Wpal( hooks: new FakeHooks(), options: new FakeOptions( [ ... ] ), ai: new FakeAi( [ 'response' ] ) )`. Use `ServiceFactory::set_custom_<service>( $mock )` for Service-layer doubles.
- Api methods throw `WordPressError` (with `errorCode`) instead of returning `WP_Error`; `find()` returns null, `get()` throws.
- Register abilities with `$wp->abilities()->define( 'my-plugin/name' )->...->register()` at any time; WPAL registers them on the right hook.
- In the plugin's release build, run `vendor/bin/wpal-prune --scan=src` after `composer install --no-dev` so the plugin ships only the WPAL services it uses.

## Docs

- [Api reference](https://github.com/merkushin/WPAL/blob/main/docs/api.md): every Api interface, builder, value object and fake, with signatures.
- [Service index](https://github.com/merkushin/WPAL/blob/main/docs/services.md): which service wraps which WordPress function.
- [README](https://github.com/merkushin/WPAL/blob/main/README.md): overview, examples, compatibility promise.

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/merkushin/WPAL/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, generated code, Api design rules, bin/wpal.
- [Triage skill](https://github.com/merkushin/WPAL/blob/main/.claude/skills/triage-wordpress-functions/SKILL.md): how WordPress functions are assigned to services.
